Khagen Dolai @ Guja vs Unknown on 7 November, 2025
46. 07.11.2025
Court
No.8 (Tanmoy)
 In The High Court At Calcutta
CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION  IA NO: CRAN/1/2025  In  CRA (DB)/252/2025
In the matter of: - KHAGEN DOLAI @ GUJA  ...applicant/appellant.
Mr. Navanil De  Mr. Srinjan Ghosh  ...for the applicant/appellant.

Ms. Faria Hossain  Mr. Sujan Chatterjee  ...for the St  Dictated by Arijit Banerjee, J.
1.
This is an application for suspension of sentence.

The applicant has been convicted of offence punishable under Section 4(2) of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act as well as under Section 376(3) of the Indian Penal Code.
2.

4.

(Smita Das De, J.) (Arijit Banerjee, J.)
